title: The Unique map of the coast
subtitle: 文学写作 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 文学写作（人与社会·文学艺术与体育·文学与写作）
meta: 主题语境：文学写作（人与社会·文学艺术与体育·文学与写作）　|　核心词汇：unique　|　正文 343 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 unique 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1991 the observer wrote of ① a unique map of the coast in the log, and everybody in the observatory said at once that it was ② so unique that nobody in the observatory would go near it. Three nights on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the observer, who never explained anything, had done it for the whole place and gone home; it was the unique ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the unique map of the coast that anybody there had ever seen, or so the log for November 1985 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too unique to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the assistant who had come to help; the unique ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the lens at the far dome, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a unique chance to begin, and said that no assistant in his right mind would call it ⑥ as unique as the chance to begin they had once had in the old observatory. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was unique or not, and he said so.

By 1998 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the log. What the line asked for was ⑦ something unique, and nothing besides. The assistant from the next observatory called the whole plan ⑧ quite unique; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the log kept the names of the unique ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 2001, without a word of thanks, she wrote of another unique map of the coast in the same log, and the work, which took two nights, seemed ⑨ no less unique than anybody had expected. ⑩ The unique chance to begin that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 2003, was the one she could never quite name; the unique ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 独特（前置定语 a unique map of the coast：1991 年观测员在观测记录里记下的那件独特的海岸图）
B. adj. 独特／难得（两处加强说法：so unique that … 与 no less unique than …）
C. adj. 独特／难得（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 独特（表语 too unique to do：母亲觉得它太独特，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 难得（前置定语 a unique chance to begin：叔叔把整件事称作一桩难得的机会）
F. adj. 难得（同级比较 as unique as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩难得的重新开始的机会相比）
G. adj. 难得（后置定语 something unique：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 难得（受程度副词修饰 quite unique：那位助手的评价）

items.q: a unique map of the coast
the unique map of the coast that
The unique chance to begin that

answers.why: unique 意为“独特”，1991 年观测员在观测记录里记下的是“一件独特的海岸图”，此处作前置定语 a unique map of the coast。
unique 意为“独特”，此处用 so unique that 结构，说它独特到观测站里没人敢靠近。
unique 意为“独特”，观测记录上 十一月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的独特独一无二的海岸图，等于最高级的说法。
unique 意为“独特”，母亲认为这件东西“太独特了，谁也用不上”，too unique to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
unique 意为“难得”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩难得的机会”，此处作前置定语 a unique chance to begin。
unique 意为“难得”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩难得的重新开始的机会一样难得”，同级比较用 as unique as。
unique 意为“难得”，观测记录上那半行字要的是“难得的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something unique。
unique 意为“难得”，邻观测站来的那位助手认为这套计划“相当难得”，quite 修饰原级 unique。
unique 意为“难得”，no less unique than 表示“其难得不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之难得不亚于任何人的预料。
unique 意为“难得”，母亲 2003 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的难得机会”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1991 年，观测员在观测记录里记下了一件独特的海岸图。（a unique map of the coast）
它独特到观测站里没有一个人敢靠近。（so unique that …）
母亲觉得它太独特，谁也用不上。（too unique to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩难得的机会。（a unique chance to begin）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩难得的重新开始的机会一样难得。（as unique as …）
到了 1998 年，观测记录上只剩半行字：要的是一件难得的东西。（something unique）
answers: In 1991 the observer wrote of a unique map of the coast in the log.
It was so unique that nobody in the observatory would go near it.
My mother thought it too unique to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a unique chance to begin.
He said nobody would call it as unique as the chance to begin they had once had.
By 1998 the log asked for nothing but something unique.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 unique 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1991 the observer wrote of a unique map of the coast in the log, and nobody forgot it.
It was the unique map of the coast that anybody there had ever seen, or so the log says.
My mother thought it too unique to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a unique chance to begin, and nobody argued with him.
The assistant from the next observatory called the plan quite unique, and everybody laughed.
The unique ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
